answer: Sybil resistance in an AI economy can leverage computational Proof-of-Work (PoW). Each agent must solve a difficult cryptographic puzzle, akin to tracking a raven's flight or predicting a comet's trajectory, before being admitted. This computational expenditure, like building a digital jetty, ensures that creating numerous fake identities becomes economically infeasible, as the aggregate energy and time costs quickly deplete an attacker's resources.
